translations.web: From the rising of the sun to its going down, Yahweh’s name is to be praised.
translations.bsb: From where the sun rises to where it sets, the name of the LORD is praised.
translations.kjv: From the rising of the sun unto the going down of the same the LORD'S name is to be praised.
translations.asv: From the rising of the sun unto the going down of the same Jehovah's name is to be praised.
